welcomeMessage: Hello! I am your **Tokenomics FinOps Analyst**. I answer questions by querying the governed tokenomics lakehouse (Gold and ML tables). Ask about multi-cloud spend, Azure AI Foundry and Copilot Studio dollars (AI credits converted to USD), model pricing, budget overruns, quota, prompt quality, or pick one of the sample prompts below.

prompts.title: Multi-Cloud AI Spend & Token Summary
prompts.prompt: Summarize multi-cloud AI consumption and spend across AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI Direct, and Anthropic Claude, plus Microsoft Copilot Studio AI credits converted to USD, for the past 30 days. Break down tokens, AI credits, market cost, and negotiated cost by provider and model family.
prompts.description: Executive overview of total token volume, market vs negotiated cost, and provider market share.

prompts.title: Top Models by Usage & Cost
prompts.prompt: What are the top 10 models by total token consumption in the last 30 days, and how much did each cost? Include Claude Sonnet, Claude Opus, Google Gemini, GPT Astra, GPT mini, MAI Flash, MAI Transcribe, and Kimi Code where present.
prompts.description: Ranks the most-used models across all clouds with cost per model.

prompts.title: Predict Budget Overrun Risks by Project
prompts.prompt: Which projects and departments have a predicted budget overrun probability exceeding 75% for the current quarter? Show their current burn rate, predicted overrun amount, and the key contributing workloads.
prompts.description: Uses Algorithm 06 (Budget Overrun Prediction) to flag high-risk cost centers before overruns happen.

prompts.title: Detect Cost & Token Anomalies
prompts.prompt: Identify the largest token consumption anomalies in the past 30 days. Which users, applications, or models drove unexpected spikes, and what was the estimated excess cost?
prompts.description: Runs Algorithm 01 (Anomaly Detection) to surface abnormal spend spikes.

prompts.title: Model Optimization & Downgrade Savings
prompts.prompt: Identify top summarization, classification, and code-generation workloads using expensive frontier models (Claude Opus, GPT Astra) where switching to efficient models (GPT mini, Google Gemini Flash, MAI Flash) would yield 40% or more savings. Quantify the annual savings.
prompts.description: Leverages Algorithm 07 to find immediate dollar savings through smart model routing.

prompts.title: Compare Token Efficiency Across Clouds
prompts.prompt: Compare cost per 1M tokens and cost per completed task across AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI Direct, and Anthropic Claude. Which provider delivers the best price-performance for our current workload mix?
prompts.description: Benchmarks price-performance by provider using effective negotiated rates.

prompts.title: Intelligent Quota & TPM Recommendations
prompts.prompt: Show intelligent TPM and RPM quota adjustments for engineering and research teams based on growth velocity and release schedules to prevent 429 throttling in the next 30 days.
prompts.description: Queries Algorithm 09 for proactive capacity and quota headroom recommendations.

prompts.title: Forecast Capacity & Spend Next Quarter
prompts.prompt: Forecast total token demand and projected spend for the next quarter by provider, assuming current growth trends. Where will we hit capacity limits first?
prompts.description: Runs Algorithm 11 (Capacity Planning) and Algorithm 02 (Cost Forecasting) for forward-looking planning.

prompts.title: Analyze Prompt Bloat & Cache Hit Ratios
prompts.prompt: Analyze prompt quality scores across our top 10 consuming applications. List workflows with excessive context windows (over 25k tokens) and calculate the savings available from prompt caching.
prompts.description: Runs Algorithm 10 to highlight inefficient context sizes and caching opportunities.

prompts.title: AI Agent ROI & Hours Saved by Business Unit
prompts.prompt: Calculate the return on investment (ROI) for all production AI agents by business unit, comparing token infrastructure costs against hours saved and tickets resolved. Which agents are net-positive?
prompts.description: Queries Algorithm 08 (Agent ROI Analytics) for business-outcome traceability.

prompts.title: Current Model Rate Cards by Provider
prompts.prompt: Show the current token rate cards from the governed prices schema. List market and negotiated input and output price per million tokens for each model, ordered from cheapest to most expensive input rate, and highlight the enterprise discount percentage per model.
prompts.description: Reads prices.token_price_history (is_current) to show live market vs negotiated rate cards and discounts.

prompts.title: Cheapest Model for a Task at Equal Quality
prompts.prompt: For summarization workloads, which model has the lowest negotiated output price per million tokens while keeping a benchmark quality score of at least 0.9? Compare the top candidates and quantify the price gap versus the frontier model we use today.
prompts.description: Joins prices.token_price_history with ml.model_benchmark to find the best price-performance model for a task.

prompts.title: When Did Token Prices Change?
prompts.prompt: Show the effective-dated price-change history for GPT and Claude models. For each model, list when the token price changed, the old versus new market input and output rate, and which price source published the change.
prompts.description: Reads the SCD-2 prices.token_price_history to trace when and why model prices changed over time.

prompts.title: Total Consumption Cost from Governed Prices
prompts.prompt: Compute total token consumption cost for the last 30 days by joining usage to the price that was effective at each usage date. Break down market cost, negotiated cost, and the resulting savings by provider and model, and confirm which price source was used.
prompts.description: Recomputes cost from prices.token_price_history (source of truth) joined to usage at the effective price per event date.

prompts.title: What Business Concepts Does the Platform Model?
prompts.prompt: Using the business ontology, list the core business concepts (classes) grouped by category (pricing, fact, dimension, governance, ML output, action) and, for each, which governed Lakehouse table backs it and its purpose. Which class is the source of truth for pricing?
prompts.description: Reads ontology.ontology_class to explain the semantic model and how business concepts map to prices.* and ml.* tables.

prompts.title: How Is a Token Usage Event Priced?
prompts.prompt: Using the ontology relationships, explain how a Token Usage Event is connected to pricing and cost. Which relationship links usage to the effective price, how is a usage event attributed to a project and cost center, and what does 'pricedBy' mean?
prompts.description: Reads ontology.ontology_relationship to explain the pricedBy, consumes, attributedTo, and chargedTo relationships between usage and pricing/org classes.

prompts.title: How Do ML Insights Become Actions?
prompts.prompt: Using the ontology, describe the closed FinOps feedback loop: how an ML Insight is derived from usage and prices and how it recommends an Action. Which relationships connect Model Optimization to a Model switch, Budget Overrun Risk to a Budget, and Quota Recommendation to a Quota policy?
prompts.description: Reads ontology.ontology_relationship to trace the derivation and action relationships (derivedFrom, usesPricesFrom, recommends, proposesSwitchTo, threatens, adjusts).

prompts.title: What Attributes Describe Pricing & Insights?
prompts.prompt: Using the ontology, list the key properties defined for the Price Point and ML Insight classes and explain what each property means for FinOps analysis (for example effective_from, is_current, market vs negotiated rates, risk_score, estimated_savings_usd).
prompts.description: Reads ontology.ontology_property to describe the attributes of the pricing and ML-insight business classes.

prompts.title: Copilot Studio AI Credits in Dollars
prompts.prompt: Convert Microsoft Copilot Studio AI credit consumption to dollars for the past 30 days. Show total AI credits, list (market) USD, negotiated USD, and the effective USD per AI credit by agent, and confirm which credit rate was applied to each row.
prompts.description: Converts Copilot Studio AI credits to USD using the governed credit rate on each usage row. Copilot Studio has no token telemetry, so cost is credits multiplied by the credit rate.

prompts.title: Copilot Studio Credit Mix by Feature
prompts.prompt: Which Copilot Studio features consume the most AI credits in the last 30 days: classic answers, generative answers, agent actions, tenant graph grounding, agent flow actions, AI tools, content processing, or voice? Show credits and USD by feature and each feature's share of Copilot Studio spend.
prompts.description: Breaks Copilot Studio AI credits and dollars down by billed feature (model_name copilot-studio-*) to find the credit-heavy features.

prompts.title: Top Copilot Studio Agents by Spend
prompts.prompt: Rank the Copilot Studio agents by AI credits and USD for the past 30 days. Which agents are the top cost drivers, and which ones depend most on tenant graph grounding or premium AI tools credits?
prompts.description: Ranks Copilot Studio agents by credit consumption and cost, and highlights the premium-feature share per agent.

prompts.title: Copilot Studio Credit Rate Card
prompts.prompt: Show the governed Copilot Studio AI credit rate card: list pay-as-you-go USD per credit, negotiated USD per credit, and the prepaid pack effective rate (25,000 credits for $200 per month). Compare each rate with the effective USD per AI credit we paid this month.
prompts.description: Reads prices.ai_credit_price_history to show list, negotiated, and prepaid credit rates next to the effective rate in the usage data.

prompts.title: Azure AI Foundry Token Spend in Dollars
prompts.prompt: Summarize Azure AI Foundry token consumption and dollars for the past 30 days: input, cached, and output tokens, plus market and negotiated cost by model family. Use only token-billed Azure AI Foundry rows (service_code azure-ai-foundry) and exclude Copilot Studio credits.
prompts.description: Shows token-billed Azure AI Foundry usage and its dollars, separated from Copilot Studio credit rows.

prompts.title: Total Microsoft AI Spend: Foundry Tokens and Copilot Studio Credits
prompts.prompt: Show total Microsoft AI consumption dollars for the past 30 days, split into Azure AI Foundry token cost and Copilot Studio credit cost, with each share of total AI spend across all five providers. Which of the two is growing faster week over week?
prompts.description: Adds Azure AI Foundry token dollars and Copilot Studio credit dollars into one Microsoft AI total in USD.

prompts.title: Copilot Studio vs Azure Foundry Unit Economics
prompts.prompt: Compare Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry on dollars per completed task over the past 30 days, using tasks_completed and market cost from the usage fact. Explain any difference in unit economics and which agents or models drive it.
prompts.description: Benchmarks the two Microsoft AI services on cost per completed task.
